questions.question: [Physics - Kinematics] Question #1: Which of the following principles correctly applies to Kinematics?
options: Option A: Conservation of Total Energy and Momentum
Option B: Inverse Square Law Proportionality
Option C: Zero Net Force in Inertial Frame
Option D: Exponential Decay Rate Parameter
questions.correctAnswer: Option A: Conservation of Total Energy and Momentum
questions.explanation: In Kinematics, energy conservation holds in closed systems without non-conservative work.
